apps.name: RadioSphere
apps.description: Radio, podcasts, lokale audio en nieuwsbulletins.
apps.changelog: Sound2U 0.3.47 RadioSphere is now Sound2U. - Complete rebrand from RadioSphere to Sound2U with a new app icon. - Added Talk2Me for saving and summarizing translated radio, podcast and news fragments. - Added separate translation controls for radio, podcasts and news bulletins. - Improved spoken-audio translation and lower-resource audio handling. - Improved duplicate station detection while preserving alternative stream qualities. - Improved support for stations with multiple directory entries, including 538 and 4EVER49. - Added WDJO / Oldies 1480 Cincinnati as a reliable searchable fallback. - WPCN / True Oldies 92.1 & 1010 remains available with SecureNet stream handling. - Fixed stale station metadata briefly appearing when switching stations through Mood. - Improved translation privacy and API-key storage. - Further battery and background-processing optimizations.

apps.name: VatRadar
apps.description: Live VATSIM-radar met vluchten, ATC, vliegvelden, routes en vliegtuigfoto's.
apps.changelog: VatRadar 1.0.0-rc3.4 Added full English language support Added language selection: System, Nederlands and English Automatically follows the device language when System is selected Improved international usability throughout the app Fixed a Compose build issue in the flight sharing function Various stability and interface improvements

apps.name: Esmarty
apps.description: Material You app voor het vinden en vergelijken van lokale prepaid-eSIMs.
apps.changelog: Esmarty changelog v0.5.3 - Added provider-aware purchase actions instead of sending every offer to a generic provider landing page. - Vodafone Netherlands now separates ordering a prepaid eSIM from viewing/activating the selected bundle. - Added exact official tariff/product links where stable for Vodafone Spain and Vodafone Germany. - Updated True-dtac Thailand and Telstra Australia to their dedicated tourist/prepaid eSIM pages. - Added clearer purchase notes for providers where activation timing or a separate bundle step matters. - Improved provider actions in offer cards, Wallet, Compare and trip recommendations. - Corrected the Orange Maroc catalog entry so Esmarty no longer presents 20 MAD as a fixed Marhaba package price. - Kept conservative official landing pages where provider checkout URLs are dynamic or may change. - All v0.5.2 interface improvements, destination imagery, Travel Assistant, Wallet, Compare and trip planning remain intact.

apps.name: SkyRadar
apps.description: Live aircraft spotting met vliegtuigfoto's, kaart, slimme meldingen en uitgebreide spotterfuncties.
apps.changelog:
SkyRadar 1.0.0-alpha13.0

- Completely redesigned Material 3 interface.
- Nearby aircraft is now the default home screen.
- Aircraft cards show photos, distance, altitude, speed, registration and aircraft type.
- Tap an aircraft to open and select it directly on the live map.
- Added smart proximity notifications.
- Filter notifications by radius, airline and aircraft type.
- Added maximum altitude filters.
- Added favorite aircraft registrations and alerts.
- Added special aircraft filtering for aircraft such as the A380, Boeing 747, Antonov and military traffic.
- Added likely-overflight detection using distance, altitude, speed and heading.
- Added Spotter section with Favorites and Today.
- Today records nearby aircraft including minimum distance and time of passage.
- Improved aircraft photo matching and caching.
- Improved location updates, navigation and overall stability.

apps.name: Customer Nearby

apps.changelog:
Customer Nearby 0.1.0

- First public release of Customer Nearby.
- Search for companies and customer service contacts worldwide.
- Automatically selects your country.
- Native Material You company profiles.
- Direct calling, email and website actions.
- Detects official WhatsApp customer service links.
- Opens WhatsApp conversations directly in the WhatsApp app.
- Dedicated outage section with company shortcuts.
- Save frequently used companies.
- Google Places support with Wikidata fallback.
